description: Claim submission contains Hospital Bill and Discharge Summary, but lacks the signed Claim Form.

source.quote: Submitted documents: Hospital Bill with receipt and Discharge Summary. Signed Claim Form was not included in package.

calculation_steps: Identified mandatory document list: claim_form, hospital_bill, discharge_summary.
Missing mandatory documents render the claim incomplete and inadmissible.
expected_findings.explanation: The mandatory Claim Form is missing from the claim submission.

source.quote: Section 1.1 (Mandatory Claim Documents): Every reimbursement claim submitted under this policy must include all three of the following documents: (1) a completed and signed Claim Form, (2) an itemized original Hospital Bill with receipt, and (3) the official Hospital Discharge Summary. If any of these three required documents is missing, the claim shall be considered incomplete and cannot be processed for reimbursement.
